changeset-claim-re-read

## ⚠️ 1 pending changeset(s) describe a file this change touches

Their bodies publish **verbatim** into the CHANGELOG at the next release, so this is a request to **re-read them against your diff** — addressed here because you are the one seat that can answer it without re-deriving anything.

⛔ Nothing here blocks, and nothing here is a verdict on your change. This gate exits 0, is not a required context, and judges **name resolution, never meaning**: it asked whether a pending body names a file you touched. "Is this sentence still true?" is the one question it will not answer, and the one you are being asked to answer.

### `.changeset/plugin-detail-8937-parent-scope-residue.md`

- names `RelatedList.tsx` → `packages/plugin-detail/src/RelatedList.tsx` — edited by this change

  > - **`packages/plugin-detail/README.md` (it is in `files[]`, so it ships).** It said the node's `filter` is AND-combined with `{ [relationshipField]: parentId }`, full stop. Since objectui#7299 the parent condition is compiled to match the relationship field's arity, so a multi-valued relationship gets `{ [relationshipField]: { $contains: parentId } }` instead. The paragraph now states both spellings and names the arbiter (`@objectstack/spec/data`'s `isMultiValueField`). - **The claim that the SQL driver decides arity on that same predicate.** It does not: `driver-sql` gates the equality family on its own storage question, which reads `multiple` as truthy on ANY type. The two rules therefore disagree for a type outside `MULTI_CAPABLE_TYPES` carrying `multiple: true`. objectui#9184 moved the arity compiler into `@object-ui/core`'s `parent-scope` seam and carried the claim with it, so the correction is recorded there — the seam now states the driver's measured rule, records the divergence as a divergence, and points at the upstream card that owns which of the two rules is right (objectstack#17469). `RelatedList.tsx`'s pointer comment and the objectui#7299 test header carried the same sentence and are corrected to match.

Read the **paragraph**, not the line: both false halves of the objectui#8617 claim sat in one paragraph, and correcting either alone would have left it asserting the same wrong thing.

If a claim did go false, **correct the body**. That is precedented and prose-only, frontmatter untouched; `check-changeset-overwrite.mjs` will report the correction as its own case 2 ("correcting a declaration on purpose … legitimate"), which is the intended shape — one gate asks for the read, the other records the write.

Not covered, stated so nobody reads this as more: a born-false claim that spells no line address at all (objectui#9495 coordinated one by ORDINAL — "a grep finds that member first" — and deciding that means reading what the sentence means), a claim spelled as a symbol or a package rather than a backticked file name, and a file named ambiguously.

Compared the checked-out tree with `1cb3732ce` (merge-base with origin/main): 2 file(s) changed outside `.changeset/`, read against 1847 pending declaration(s) that publish a body (2459 pending in total). · [run](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/actions/runs/36781503751)

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `c0d0a869b95bd20c13073a20bd88114d9a3624a0`
Local-runs: none

Inputs, and nothing else: card objectui#11244 (body; triage `5917804144`; claim `5919596741`; dev report `5920356661`), PR objectui#11275 (body, `/files`: 3 files, +75 / −1), the net diff `git diff 18d1a0abd3 c0d0a869b9` (`18d1a0abd3` is the head's merge base with current `origin/main`), and the head's check-runs, read twice. Read-only context: objectui#3812, objectui#3842, objectui#3960, objectui#11212, PR objectui#11237. No worktree, build, test or gate run.

**The head is a merge commit** (`c0d0a869b9` = branch `58ff0831ef` + main `18d1a0abd3`). `git diff-tree --cc` on it is EMPTY, so it carries no conflict-resolution edit; the +/− lines of the pre-merge diff (`f4ed2387e9..58ff0831ef`) and the post-merge diff (`18d1a0abd3..c0d0a869b9`) are byte-identical. Main's own hunk in `RelatedList.tsx` between the two bases is `@@ -1573,13 +1573,13 @@` (PR objectui#11264's `reference` key), disjoint from the gate at `:456`. The three PR files are the whole net diff.

### ① Derived judgments

1. **The gate.** `packages/plugin-detail/src/RelatedList.tsx:456` reads `if (hasDeclaredVisibilityGate(visiblePred) && !isVisible) return null;`, replacing the truthiness test. The helper is imported from `@object-ui/components` (`:28`), where the barrel re-exports core's one definition `hasDeclaredPredicate` (`components/src/index.ts:60`, `visibility-gate.ts`); no copy, no second helper, no new function anywhere in the diff. That is triage's direction (`5917804144`) word for word: `hasDeclaredVisibilityGate(visiblePred)` for the test, ⛔ no second gate helper honoured. **Right.**
2. **The fault leg is unchanged.** `useCondition(toPredicateInput(visiblePred), undefined, { throwOnError: true, label })` at `:452–455` is untouched by the diff (only the `if` line and the header comment moved). PR objectui#11237's fail-closed policy on a fault stands. **Right.**
3. **Accept-set.** `RelatedRowActionDef` (`react/src/context/RelatedRecordActionsContext.tsx:39`) admits `visible` through its index signature `[k: string]: unknown`; no type, zod mirror, prop or export changed. A value the surface already accepted (`visible: false`) changes verdict from shown to hidden: a bug fix on an existing accept-set, not a widening. `Clause-②: no` is the right reading. **Right.**
4. **Whitespace-only `visible`: hidden before, shown after.** Follows from the ruled helper: `hasDeclaredPredicate` folds `''`, whitespace-only text and a blank-`source` envelope to "not declared" (objectui#3850 / objectui#3960, `core/src/evaluator/declaredPredicate.ts`). It IS the family's rule on the sibling surfaces: `DeclaredActionsBar.tsx:346` and `useNavRunAction.ts:170` both ask the same helper, so whitespace is "no gate" there too, and the helper's own docblock records the same `'   '` HIDDEN to shown move on `action:button`. Disclosed in the changeset ("A whitespace-only `visible` used to hide the button; it now shows"), in the PR's before/after table, and pinned by the `it.each` blank row in `related-toolbar-visible.test.tsx`. The one new side effect the helper brings, a once-per-spelling `[blank]` report on a blank gate (ADR-0137 D4), is family-wide and the pin's `console.warn` spy covers it. **Right, and correctly disclosed.**
5. **The three pins triage asked for** are present in one new `describe` block, rendering the real component from `../RelatedList` through `PredicateScopeProvider`: `visible: false` hides (the DETECTOR, with a companion button proving the render), `visible: true` shows, `''` and `'   '` show as no gate, a CEL string is evaluated (`'1 == 1'` shows, `'1 == 2'` hides). The dev's red-first run reports exactly the two rows the truthiness gate gets wrong (`false`, whitespace), and the ablation turned the same two red again. **Right.**
6. **The fault leg needs no new pin.** Both existing pins exercise this exact component at the head: the objectui#11212 block in the same file imports `RelatedToolbarButton` from `../RelatedList` and renders `visible: 'nope.deep == 1'`; app-shell's `currentUserCan-failClosed-11212.render.test.tsx:74` imports it from `../../../../plugin-detail/src/RelatedList` (source, not dist) and drives it through `VISIBLE_LEGS` (not-loaded / granted / denied, plus the unbound-root fault at `:349–357`). After the change the helper answers `true` for any non-blank string, so a faulting predicate still reaches `!isVisible` and the hide still depends on `throwOnError`; removing that option would fail-soft to shown and turn both pins red, independently of the helper. **Right.**
7. **Public surface and reach.** `RelatedToolbarButton` is not a package export (`plugin-detail/src/index.tsx` exports `RelatedList` and `RelatedListProps`); it is mounted from `permittedToolbarActions` at `RelatedList.tsx:2292–2293`, which the `related-list` / `related_list` registry types and `renderers/record-related-list.tsx:442` all reach through `RelatedList`. So the `record:related_list` public door named on the card is covered without touching that renderer or `deriveActions`, as the claim forbade. `@object-ui/components` was already a peer (`workspace:^`) and dev dependency of `@object-ui/plugin-detail`; no manifest changed. **Right.**
8. **Sweep.** A grep of `packages/plugin-detail/src` non-test source at the head for a `visible` / `disabled` / `enabled` / `hidden` value joined by `&&` finds only `:456`, now the helper. The pending changeset that names `RelatedList.tsx` (`plugin-detail-8937-parent-scope-residue.md`) is about the parent-scope pointer comment at `:474–500`, which this diff does not touch. **Right.**

### ② Semver level

`.changeset/11244-related-toolbar-visible-gate.md` declares `'@object-ui/plugin-detail': patch`. The diff publishes one behaviour fix in one package's shipped source and consumes an already-exported helper of a package it already depends on; no export, type, manifest or accepted shape changes, so nothing else needs a bump and `patch` is the level. The changeset text names both verdict moves (`false` now hides; whitespace now shows) and the unchanged fault leg. The PR body and the claim both carry `Clause-②: no`, and ① item 3 confirms it. Check-runs `Changeset Declaration`, `Changeset Bump Policy`, `Changeset Fixed Group Check`, `Changeset Claim Re-read` and `Changeset Overwrite Report` all concluded `success`. **Right.**

### ③ Boundary flags

Dev `deviations` (5), `open_questions` (none), `out_of_scope_findings` (3), and the head's check-runs:

- **Deviation 1, whitespace flip.** Answered in ① item 4: the family's rule, disclosed and pinned. Not a separate change. Accepted.
- **Deviation 2, no new fault-leg pin.** Answered in ① item 6: both existing pins render this component from source at the head and remain detectors of `throwOnError`. Accepted.
- **Deviation 3, commit trailers.** The four branch commits carry the `Claude-Session` trailer plus a co-author line that names no model; a process note under objectui `AGENTS.md`, with no bearing on the contract. Noted.
- **Deviation 4, worktree removed after the PR opened.** Process; no bearing. Noted.
- **Deviation 5, resume notice.** The PR head is `c0d0a869b9`, which already merges main `18d1a0abd3`; main has since moved to `1cb3732ce2` with no change under `packages/plugin-detail`, and the PR reads `mergeable: true`. The merge queue rebuilds on main. Noted.
- **Finding 1, no other truthiness gate in plugin-detail.** Confirmed by my own grep (① item 8). Acceptance notes; nothing to file.
- **Finding 2, `DetailTabs` never evaluates a string `visible`.** Confirmed by reading: `DetailTabs.tsx:28–33` returns `true` for any string ("Simple expression evaluation could go here"), while `DetailViewTabSchema.visible` admits `z.union([z.boolean(), z.string()])` (`types/src/zod/views.zod.ts:146`) and `DetailView.tsx:2023–2024` passes `schema.tabs` through unfiltered. It is NOT this card's family: the objectui#3812 class mis-classifies a DECLARED gate by truthiness (a boolean `false` renders), whereas here the boolean is honoured and the authorable string is inert, never evaluated (an unenforced authorable key, the enforce-or-remove class). As it stands it fails the filing gate on both legs: the dev's jsdom probe went through the `DetailView` component, not the registered `detail-view` node, and no in-repo producer emits `tabs`. It belongs in Acceptance notes, where the dev put it, and would become fileable on its own card (not a rider on objectui#11244) with one probe through the registered `detail-view` renderer carrying authored `tabs`, or a named producer. Not blocking.
- **Finding 3, `isCustomRowActionVisible` as a second "declared?" definition.** Read-only inference, and the reading holds at the head: `components/src/renderers/complex/data-table.tsx:286` and `plugin-grid/src/components/RowActionMenu.tsx:248` ask `pred == null || pred === ''`, then `evalRowActionVisibility` hands a whitespace-only string to `evalRowPredicate` with `fallback: false`, which returns the fallback on `!source.trim()` (`core/src/evaluator/listConditional.ts:253`). So on the row path a whitespace-only `visible` HIDES the action, while the helper's family (and this PR's toolbar) SHOW it: a verdict-level divergence, the objectui#3960 blank-spelling class, contradicting `declaredPredicate.ts`'s claim that nothing else in the repo asks the question. Unmeasured and without a named producer, it belongs in Acceptance notes as it stands; it is one row-menu probe away from fileable on its own card. Not blocking here.
- **Check-runs on `c0d0a869b9`** (42 runs): 31 concluded `success` (including `Lint`, `Type Check`, `Test (shard 1/8)`, `Test (dist pins)`, `Build & E2E`, `Build Docs`, `Bundle Analysis`, the five changeset gates, `Line Citation Gate`, `Control Byte Scan`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `label`); 3 `skipped` (`Test (coverage)`, the templated coverage-shard lane, `dependabot`, the usual skip lanes); none `failure`. **Not concluded, named and not adopted either way:** `Test (shard 2/8)`, `Test (shard 3/8)`, `Test (shard 4/8)`, `Test (shard 5/8)`, `Test (shard 6/8)`, `Test (shard 7/8)`, `Test (shard 8/8)`, `Spec Main Shape Gate`, all still `in_progress` at the second read. This verdict is on the contract; the merge queue holds on those eight.
